traditional.five: 汉中王, human commander, emerald-white layered king robe and bronze-gold lamellar shoulders, paired straight swords, compassionate commanding face, broad noble golden dragon
traditional.six: 章武帝业, more magnificent emerald-white emperor battle regalia, towering winglike ceremonial shoulders and imperial jade crown, two long straight swords, huge five-clawed golden dragon sheltering army
traditional.bio5: Hanzhong victory leads to kingship: Liu Bei stands prominently on an earthen proclamation platform with generals diminished in background, river and Shu mountains, receiving a king seal
traditional.bio6: An original mythic interpretation of chapter 80 founding Shu-Han: standing Liu Bei solemnly raises the imperial seal before an earthly Chengdu palace, officials bow below, a giant golden dragon wakes overhead, no Guan Yu or Zhang Fei falsely present as living at ceremony

divine.five: 昭烈仁祠, original deified Liu Bei inspired by memorial reverence, flowing white-jade and emerald sacred robes, subtle temple-architecture crown, gold yellow guardian dragon and broad protective halos, open gentle palms, no aggressive warrior imitation
divine.six: 万民昭烈, far grander benevolent celestial sovereign in emerald-white structured sacred robes, floating jade seal, huge layered protective lotuslike golden dragon sanctuary arcs, powerful humane not monstrous
divine.bio5: Later generations visiting a real earthly Han Zhaolie memorial temple: human worshippers small, central remembered Liu Bei steps out of a carved commemorative image as golden dragon light shelters people. Clearly fictional apotheosis from memorial reverence not a canonical religious deity
divine.bio6: Original divine upgrade: memorial votive ribbons from different generations become one immense protective golden dragon canopy, Liu Bei takes a step forward and opens hands to shelter families beneath, earthly temple courtyard remains recognizable

demonic.five: 白帝遗恨, original tragic dark Liu Bei after defeat and death, recognizable benevolent face now grieving and resolute, cracked emerald black armor and ragged white cloak with muted crimson underside, dark gold skeletal-wingless dragon soul shielding spectral comrades, no gore no skull-faced hero
demonic.six: 烬汉幽皇, grander tragic revenge emperor, obsidian emerald imperial armor jagged but refined silhouette, crimson inner cloak, luminous pale-gold woundless spirit seams, enormous fierce dark-gold ghost dragon guards phantom army, distinct from Guan Yu berserker
demonic.bio5: Original fantasy transformation at Baidi deathbed chapter85: dying Liu Bei's recognizable face appears in rising spectral form above a dim royal bedside, Zhuge Liang small and subdued, remote Yiling burnt banners remembered through window, tragic gold-black dragon wakes to protect orphaned followers, no gore
demonic.bio6: Original further transformation: Liu Bei's ghostly emperor form kneels then rises on the grounded ashes of Yiling with spectral fallen army gathering under a great dark golden dragon canopy; revenge is grieving collective protection not mindless slaughter

mecha.five: 龙枢统御, technology civilization reconstructs Liu Bei consciousness in emerald-white medical command exoskeleton, human face visible, short black beard, angular jade-gold chest core, articulated segmented gold dragon drone, twin rigid plasma swords and deployable shield projectors
mecha.six: 天汉龙枢, vastly grander sovereign command mecha, human Liu Bei face exposed in tall armored collar, emerald-white heavy floating medical command wings, gold dragon reactor and large segmented dragon escort drones, twin rigid energy swords, layered tactical protection field
mecha.bio5: Original future civilization identity reconstruction: Liu Bei's recognizable human face awakens inside an open emerald-white command armor cradle, faint historical green robe hologram becomes mechanical plates, a segmented golden dragon drone activates, clean high-tech hangar
mecha.bio6: Original technology upgrade: Liu Bei in supreme command armor synchronizes a battlefield network of healing drones beneath an immense segmented golden mechanical dragon, grounded evacuation convoy and wounded soldiers safely sheltered in the background, heroic leader strongest visual
